Markup-fidelity fixture for the PARAGRAPH typography component (svelte typography/Paragraph.svelte, keen Typography.paragraph/1). SCOPE = a single flat element: core's canonical paragraph is `

` — the BEM paragraph-typography component from _utilities.scss (snippets/typography.html). The base `.pa-text` carries 14px + primary colour; modifiers tune size (xs/sm/lg/xl), colour (primary/secondary), logical alignment (start/center/end), and compound semantic styles (caption/lead). All `.pa-text--*` modifiers claimed below are exactly the set in main.css. See label.json for the flat-element-with-modifiers model.

propsVocabulary.color: colour modifier primary|secondary → pa-text--{value} (primary = default colour; secondary = muted)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (class passthrough — not a core feature)

goldenConventions:
Structural only. Base is always `

`; a modifier class is added per set feature. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks tag + class + nesting, not rich content. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The full .pa-text--* set in main.css is exactly: xs, sm, lg, xl (4 sizes), primary, secondary (2 colours), start, center, end (3 alignments), caption, lead (2 semantics) — all 11 claimed below. Base `.pa-text` exists as a real rule. `produces: null` only for the slot + class passthrough.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: All 11 pa-text--* modifiers are feature-driven; none are JS-toggled state classes.
